fix(settings): name-based storage proposals are opt-in (#50)

Proposals filled the storage class selects on load, so the report tab
opened with unsaved changes and the leave guard fired without any edit.
They now appear as an "Applica le proposte dal nome (N storage)" button
that applies them as a normal unsaved change.

* feat(settings): per-cluster network values for new VMs (ROADMAP 25)

New Settings tab "Infrastruttura": networks (CIDR + gateway), DNS and
search domain per cluster, GET/PUT /api/clusters/{idx}/network-settings.
New VM picks the gateway from the network containing the IP, DNS and
domain from the cluster (the hard-coded DNS is gone), warns when the IP is
outside the known networks; precedence: typed by hand > cluster > template.
The provisioning job accepts an optional validated search_domain
(cloud-init searchdomain). Unsaved-changes guard now covers both forms.
